result.reason: The redline appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors acting on Client’s behalf without altering the permitted-use scope. However, it does not satisfy even the fallback because it adds no transfer right for a successor in an M&A transaction. It also leaves the licence terminable whenever the Agreement is terminated, rather than addressing the preferred duration and termination protections for paid-up and subscription licences. The drafting is generally professional, though “its business” is potentially ambiguous after adding affiliates and contractors.
